mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in economic demand (GDPC1) over the past quarter signals robust growth, which lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in > 70% of instances where GDPC1 shows upward trend, or the trend reverses (GDPC1 < previous month's value within 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in economic demand (GDPC1) signal accommodative monetary policy and robust demand, both compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < previous month's value AND GDPC1 > previous month's value
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in > 60% of instances where the interaction occurs, or the policy shift is not sustained (FEDFUNDS rises within 2 months).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals monetary tightening, which compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the rate rise is not sustained (FEDFUNDS < previous month's value within 2 months).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 8.5% signals labor market strengthening, reducing uncertainty and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in > 70% of instances where UNRATE <8.5% for 3 months, or the decline in UNRATE is not sustained (rate rises above 8.5% within 1 month).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the supply index below 92.5 signals contraction in production capacity, raising inflation expectations and prompting the Fed to maintain tight monetary policy, which compresses discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in > 60% of instances where INDPRO <92.5, or the supply contraction is not sustained (INDPRO recovers within 2 months).

mechanism_narrative: The combined effect of a declining federal funds rate (easing) and rising economic demand (GDPC1) creates a synergistic accommodative environment, lowering discount rates more effectively than either factor alone, thereby boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < previous month's value AND GDPC1 > previous month's value
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in > 60% of instances where the interaction occurs, or the policy shift is not sustained (FEDFUNDS rises within 2 months).

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary environment, a decline in the federal funds rate below 1.0% signals aggressive monetary easing to stimulate the economy, which reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS <1.0% in recessionary regimes, or the rate decline is not sustained (FEDFUNDS rises within 3 months).
